findings.reason: a wrong population measure sends the node to dedupe test functions instead of helpers, so the gate can pass green while the declared deliverable is untouched.
findings.text: §4's done-when counts "module-level test functions whose normalised body ... is identical to one in another test file", but the deliverable it must measure is helper fixtures (`config_home`, `_spawn_runner`, `_row`, `checkout`, `_placed_backend`, ...); the health review uses "test functions" for `test_*` bodies (T7: "11 test functions are byte-identical copies"), so a node implementing the wording literally counts the ~11 duplicated `test_*` bodies and moves those, leaving the ~202 helper copies the section exists to remove — and the same sentence demands zero identical bodies suite-wide while the deliverable scopes work to helpers copied across three or more files

findings.reason: the gate and the stated placement rule can disagree, so the node either fails its own done-when or silently ignores the section's instruction.
findings.text: §4 says fixtures "move to `tests/conftest.py` only when every importer is in the suite's root", but a `tests/conftest.py` fixture is visible to every module under `tests/`, including sub-directories, so the condition is false and a node honouring it will leave body-identical fixtures whose importers span sub-directory roots duplicated, which the done-when's "falls to zero outside `tests/helpers/`" then forbids

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — the cited clone evidence resolves (`health-test-suite/clones.json`, `clones.log`, `browser-probe.log` all present), `tests/conftest.py` is 1,231 lines as §6 states, `reckon/crew/standing_suite.py:164/285` name `_result_counts`/`_build_counts` as §3 claims, and `_row` is defined in 39 test files as §1 states.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §4's done-when measures "module-level test functions", a population that is not the helper fixtures the section exists to dedupe.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §4's before/after counts land in the manifest and the counting script sits beside the run's log, both on the durable report/log path the dispatch names; nothing is written to a session scratchpad or node-local temp.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §4 introduces no plan labels, stage names, ticket numbers or version tags into any symbol, path or comment.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §4's mechanism (move fixtures to `tests/conftest.py`) is gated on an incorrect condition about pytest fixture visibility, so it can leave the very duplicates its done-when forbids.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §4 carries one deliverable (give the duplicated helpers one home); the conftest clause is a placement detail of that same deliverable, not a second goal.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — the plan declares `plan-after the-suite-is-green-at-head` and `plan-standalone`; `docs/plans/the-suite-is-green-at-head.html` exists and §4 waits on no other plan, while §5's ordering after §4 is stated in the followup rather than as a wrong edge.
